correctness.rationale: Geometric fixed faces consist of whole edge orbits, with rung singleton and horizontal paired-edge orbits. The orbit complex equals the ordinary matching complex of fully whiskered C_n, because symmetric partial matchings extend to prism perfect matchings using unused rungs. Fiberwise whisker toggle changes no core-edge set, while unmatched downward steps can only remove core edges; a directed cycle cannot cross fibers, nor remain within one toggle fiber. Critical cells are one 0-cell and the core perfect matchings: two alternating n/2-edge matchings for even n, none for odd n. Morse CW gives wedge of two spheres in degree n/2-1 or a point.
